verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM runs entirely on the user's machine and keeps its document knowledge base local. A community report adds that users can choose their own embedders and vector stores, so the local half of the story is supported. Nothing in the pack shows a user-facing memory store that can be inspected, edited, or deleted, nor that it uses an open format. Missing for 10: documented memory inspection, edit, and delete controls; evidence of an open or portable memory storage format; any independent hands-on corroboration of memory management.
